description: A ground-level photograph depicting a wet, muddy salt marsh or intertidal flat landscape. The foreground shows shallow pools of water reflecting the sky, interspersed with extensive patches of light green algae or low-lying vegetation and darker clumps of denser vegetation or rocks. In the background, a line of trees or shrubs forms the horizon under a blue sky with scattered clouds.
